title: Quinoa with Feta and Mint
description:
Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Add 1 cup of quinoa and simmer, covered, until tender, fluffy, and water is absorbed — about 15 minutes. Let stand, covered, off the heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. (This yields about 4 cups cooked quinoa.)
Toss with 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint, a handful of crumbled feta, a handful of thawed frozen peas, squeeze of lemon, and a drizzle of olive oil, and salt and pepper. If you are so inclined, add a dollop of plain yogurt.

Toss with 1 tablespoon chopped fresh mint, a handful of crumbled feta, a handful of thawed frozen peas, squeeze of lemon, and a drizzle of olive oil, and salt and pepper. If you are so inclined, add a dollop of plain yogurt.
